question_papers.paper_title: Another Peek Beyond the Point - Unified Practice Assessment

questions.question_text: What is the place value of digit 3 in 27.53?
Convert 2/5 into decimal form.
Convert 35 cm into meters.
Convert 68 grams into kilograms.
Which ancient Indian mathematical text contains division problems convertible into modern decimal operations?
What is 0.2 × 0.3?
Write 27.53 in expanded form showing place values.
Convert into decimal form using equivalent fractions: (a) 13/4, (b) 4/50, (c) 5/8.
State the rule for placing decimal point when multiplying two decimal numbers.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Multiply the numbers as whole integers, then count total decimal places in both factors and place decimal point that many places from the right in the product.

questions.question_text: Explain the decimal shift method for dividing 22.5 by 0.5.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Multiply both dividend and divisor by 10 to clear divisor decimal: (22.5 × 10) / (0.5 × 10) = 225 / 5 = 45.

questions.question_text: Convert: (a) 5.5 km to meters, (b) 125.5 mL to liters.
Express in kg using decimals: 5 kg 8 g and 25 kg 750 g.
A sheet of paper is 0.12 mm thick. Find total thickness of a stack of 500 such sheets in cm.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Total thickness in mm = 500 × 0.12 = 60 mm. Convert to cm = 60 / 10 = 6 cm.

questions.question_text: Four friends want to divide a 29-meter roll of ribbon equally among themselves. (a) Express share as fraction. (b) Convert fraction to decimal. (c) How many meters does each friend receive?
questions.marking_scheme_answer: (a) Share = 29 / 4. (b) 29 / 4 = (29 × 25) / (4 × 25) = 725 / 100 = 7.25. (c) Each friend receives 7.25 meters of ribbon.

questions.question_text: A rectangular garden plot is 12.4 meters long and 8.5 meters wide. (a) Calculate area of garden. (b) If fencing costs ₹45.50 per meter, calculate total cost to fence perimeter.
A vehicle covers a distance of 43.2 km in 2.4 liters of petrol. (a) Calculate distance covered per liter. (b) How many liters are needed for 108 km?
questions.marking_scheme_answer: (a) Distance per liter = 43.2 ÷ 2.4 = 432 ÷ 24 = 18 km per liter. (b) Petrol required = 108 / 18 = 6 liters.

questions.question_text: Each side of a regular polygon is 2.5 cm long. Its perimeter is 12.5 cm. (a) Calculate number of sides. (b) Identify name of polygon.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: (a) Number of sides = Perimeter / Side length = 12.5 / 2.5 = 125 / 25 = 5 sides. (b) Name = Regular Pentagon.

questions.question_text: A chef requires 0.45 kg of flour to bake one cake. He has 11.25 kg of flour. (a) How many cakes can he bake? (b) If he bakes 18 cakes, how much flour is left?
questions.marking_scheme_answer: (a) Cakes = 11.25 / 0.45 = 1125 / 45 = 25 cakes. (b) Flour used for 18 cakes = 18 × 0.45 = 8.1 kg. Flour left = 11.25 - 8.1 = 3.15 kg.

questions.question_text: A grocery store lists items per kg: Sugar ₹42.50, Rice ₹58.25, Flour ₹32.80. (a) Convert 1/4 kg sugar to decimal weight. (b) Cost of 1/4 kg sugar. (c) Total cost of 2 kg rice and 500 g flour.
A car covers 16.5 km per liter of petrol. Fuel tank holds 35.5 liters. (a) How far can car travel on a full tank? (b) If petrol costs ₹96.50 per liter, calculate cost of full tank.
A tailor has a roll of cloth measuring 37.8 meters. Each shirt requires 1.8 meters of cloth. (a) How many shirts can be stitched? (b) If each shirt sells for ₹450.50, find total earnings.

A juice vendor buys 15.5 L of orange juice. He serves it in small cups of capacity 250 mL (0.25 L). (a) Convert 15.5 L to mL. (b) How many cups can he serve? (c) If each cup costs ₹15, find total income.
A school buys 45 notebooks at ₹28.50 each and 30 pens at ₹15.25 each. (a) Total cost of notebooks. (b) Total cost of pens. (c) Overall bill amount.
